label: Basic
description: Basic scroll area. Best for a narrow column of 30 version tags under a Releases heading, split by rules, that only scrolls up and down.

label: Horizontal
description: Sideways scroll area. Best for one row of 10 photo cards that pans sideways, in a box only as tall as the row.

label: Both Scrollbars
description: Scroll area both ways. Best for an 8 plan pricing table with a price column and 6 feature columns that pans across and down.

label: Fade Edges
description: Scroll area with fading edges. Best for edges that fade only while content is hidden past them, over a column of photos.

label: Scrollbar Gutter
description: Scroll area with a gutter. Best for full width photos that gain room on the scrollbar's side once the column overflows, keeping the bar clear of them.
